knowledge.title: Quadratic equations
knowledge.text: A quadratic equation has the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0. It is solved with the quadratic formula x = (-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a. The discriminant b^2 - 4ac tells you the number of real roots: positive gives two, zero gives one, negative gives none.

knowledge.title: Pythagorean theorem
knowledge.text: In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a^2 + b^2 = c^2. It is used to find missing side lengths and distances.

knowledge.title: Percentages
knowledge.text: A percentage is a fraction out of 100. To find p percent of a number N, compute N x p / 100. Percentage change is (new - old) / old x 100.

knowledge.title: Probability basics
knowledge.text: Probability of an event is favourable outcomes divided by total outcomes, always between 0 and 1. For independent events the probability that both happen is the product of their probabilities.

knowledge.title: Photosynthesis
knowledge.text: Photosynthesis is how plants make food. Chlorophyll in the leaves absorbs sunlight and uses it to turn carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light -> C6H12O6 + 6O2.

knowledge.title: Newton's laws of motion
knowledge.text: First law: an object stays at rest or in uniform motion unless acted on by a force (inertia). Second law: force equals mass times acceleration, F = ma. Third law: every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

knowledge.title: Water cycle
knowledge.text: The water cycle moves water between the Earth and atmosphere. Evaporation turns water into vapour, condensation forms clouds, precipitation brings rain or snow, and collection gathers water in rivers, lakes and oceans.

knowledge.title: Acids and bases
knowledge.text: Acids have a pH below 7 and taste sour, bases have a pH above 7 and feel slippery, and pH 7 is neutral. Acid plus base gives salt and water in a neutralisation reaction.

knowledge.title: Variables and data types
knowledge.text: A variable stores a value under a name. Common data types are integers, floats, strings and booleans. In Python you create a variable by assigning, for example age = 18.

knowledge.title: Loops
knowledge.text: Loops repeat code. A for loop iterates over a sequence such as a list or range, and a while loop repeats as long as a condition is true. Take care to avoid infinite loops by updating the condition.

knowledge.title: Functions
knowledge.text: A function is a reusable block of code that takes inputs called parameters and can return a value. In Python you define one with def name(params): and call it with name(args). Functions reduce repetition and make code easier to test.

knowledge.title: Machine learning basics
knowledge.text: Machine learning lets computers learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules. Supervised learning trains on labelled examples, unsupervised learning finds structure in unlabelled data, and the trained model makes predictions on new data.

knowledge.title: Parts of speech
knowledge.text: The main parts of speech are noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction and interjection. Each describes the job a word does in a sentence.

knowledge.title: Active and passive voice
knowledge.text: In active voice the subject performs the action: The dog chased the cat. In passive voice the subject receives the action: The cat was chased by the dog. Active voice is usually clearer and more direct.

knowledge.title: Writing a good paragraph
knowledge.text: A strong paragraph has a topic sentence that states the main idea, supporting sentences with evidence or examples, and a concluding sentence that links back to the idea.
